_note: The canned FRONT-FACING standing skeleton, for a base the concept stage rendered. SYNTHESISED from joint coordinates, not traced from a photograph, so it carries no licence of any kind. Front view facing the viewer, which is what CONCEPT_TXT2IMG_PROMPT asks the model for ('front-view', 'facing forward, facing the viewer'). Its sibling stand_pose.json is a SIDE view and stays the pose `anim base` renders through the ControlNet; this one is never rendered from, it exists so the part prompts (anim.partkit.prompts_for) land on a front-facing figure. Measured 2026-09-25 against both concept bases on disk: joints sit inside the silhouette of knight_base (bbox x 80-702) and hooded_archer_base (bbox x 203-559) at every row they are placed on - the ears at +/-40 because the knight's helm is only 426px wide at y152, the ankles at +/-78 because the knight's feet run x 251-312 and x 404-518 at y706. Framed for the 768 concept cell: centre x 384, head top ~30, feet ~740. Edit the numbers here to change the front base pose.
